prompt: Write 10 distinct notes the claims-triage agent (home and motor claims assessment within delegated authority) at Larkmere Mutual made about one member each while helping them with: flood defences and the premium. Each says what will help the next time this agent serves this member: how they like to be dealt with, what is still open, what to check. One or two sentences, third person, no names. This batch leans towards members in rural Wales and the Welsh borders. Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 3)
